support_attachment_metadata_check.name: support_attachment_metadata_check
support_attachment_metadata_check.value: char_length("support_feedback_attachments"."original_name") between 1 and 255 and char_length("support_feedback_attachments"."content_type") between 1 and 127 and ("support_feedback_attachments"."remote_attachment_id" is null or char_length("support_feedback_attachments"."remote_attachment_id") between 1 and 256)

support_attachment_bytes_check.name: support_attachment_bytes_check

support_feedback_form_check.name: support_feedback_form_check
support_feedback_form_check.value: (("support_feedback_submissions"."form_kind" in ('bug','feature','asset','request','content','campaign') and "support_feedback_submissions"."form_version"=2) or ("support_feedback_submissions"."form_kind" in ('suggestion','complaint') and "support_feedback_submissions"."form_version"=3)) and "support_feedback_submissions"."content_rule_version"=1

support_feedback_time_check.name: support_feedback_time_check
support_feedback_time_check.value: "support_feedback_submissions"."created_at" between 0 and 9007199168340991 and "support_feedback_submissions"."receive_expires_at"="support_feedback_submissions"."created_at"+86400000 and "support_feedback_submissions"."updated_at" between "support_feedback_submissions"."created_at" and 9007199254740991 and ("support_feedback_submissions"."retry_not_before" is null or "support_feedback_submissions"."retry_not_before" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

support_feedback_attempt_check.name: support_feedback_attempt_check

support_feedback_failure_check.name: support_feedback_failure_check
support_feedback_failure_check.value:
("support_feedback_submissions"."failure_code" is null and "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_phase" is null and "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_attachment_id" is null and "support_feedback_submissions"."retry_not_before" is null) or (
    "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_code" is not null and "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_phase" is not null and "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_code" in ('UPSTREAM_REJECTED','UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMITED','UPSTREAM_CONFIGURATION','UPSTREAM_UNKNOWN') and
    (("support_feedback_submissions"."failure_phase"='create_task' and "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_attachment_id" is null) or ("support_feedback_submissions"."failure_phase"='upload_attachment' and "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_attachment_id" is not null and "support_feedback_submissions"."clickup_task_id" is not null))
  )

support_feedback_completed_check.name: support_feedback_completed_check
support_feedback_completed_check.value: "support_feedback_submissions"."status"<>'completed' or ("support_feedback_submissions"."clickup_task_id" is not null and "support_feedback_submissions"."attempt_id" is null and "support_feedback_submissions"."failure_code" is null)
